name: github
description: Manage repos, issues, pull requests, and Actions.

GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: GitHub personal access token
GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Fine-grained or classic PAT from https://github.com/settings/tokens. Must be set as this plugin's setup field (not a messaging-channel secret). Empty values produce Authorization: Bearer  which GitHub rejects as badly formatted.
